_doc: NOIR language pack - English reference. To add a language: copy this file to <code>.json (e.g. it.json), set name, and translate the VALUES only (never the keys). builder = texts of NOIR Builder, remote = texts on the remote's screen (keep them short: 240 px wide). Missing texts show in English. Check with: python3 tools/check_languages.py
name: English

builder.Name: Name
builder.Saved – the remote updates in a few seco: Saved – the remote updates in a few seconds.
builder.What you see left is what your remote sh: What you see left is what your remote shows.
builder.Tap a tile to edit it: Tap a tile to edit it
builder.Brand not listed? See docs/tv.md – one s: Brand not listed? See docs/tv.md – one small file adds it.
builder.Switches on with the TV, gets the volume: Switches on with the TV, gets the volume keys.
builder.Speaker does not switch on? Choose the s: Speaker does not switch on? Choose the source it plays the TV on – choosing a source wakes it up.
Tap one below to add it. Up to 8.
Tap one below to add it. Up to 6.
builder.Choose your TV first – its inputs and ap: Choose your TV first – its inputs and apps appear here.
builder.Switch your TV on – its inputs and apps: Switch your TV on – its inputs and apps then appear here.
builder.Install the firmware from your browser (: Install the firmware from your browser (Chrome or Edge): connect the remote by USB and press Install.
builder.Connect your phone to the Wi-Fi network: Connect your phone to the Wi-Fi network “noir-remote setup” and choose your own Wi-Fi.
builder.Done: Home Assistant adds the remote by: Done: Home Assistant adds the remote by itself – no keys, no files.
builder.No update found on your remote yet. Remo: No update found on your remote yet. Remotes with firmware 0.2 install the new firmware once via the installer (USB); after that, updates come here with one button.
keep the remote close to your Wi-Fi.
builder.Started – the remote restarts when it is: Started – the remote restarts when it is done.
builder.Per room: a climate entity in Home Assis: Per room: a climate entity in Home Assistant (any brand, e.g. an ESP32 module on the airco), or the remote's own infrared.
builder.Via Home Assistant the remote shows the: Via Home Assistant the remote shows the modes, fan and swing settings your airco has. Infrared: the remote remembers what it sent (the airco reports nothing back).
builder.Add a tile “Airco screen” on Home to ope: Add a tile “Airco screen” on Home to open it.
builder.Add a tile “Audio screen” on Home to ope: Add a tile “Audio screen” on Home to open it.
builder.On/off, source and volume go to this spe: On/off, source and volume go to this speaker. The volume keys of the remote too.
builder.Choose your speaker first – its sources: Choose your speaker first – its sources appear here.
builder.Switch your speaker on – its sources the: Switch your speaker on – its sources then appear here.
builder.The player that shows what is playing an: The player that shows what is playing and gets play/pause and next. Empty = the speaker itself.
builder.A number entity with the subwoofer level: A number entity with the subwoofer level, e.g. the KEF's.
builder.Home Assistant is restarting – this page: Home Assistant is restarting – this page reloads by itself.
builder.Home Assistant restarts: lights, automat: Home Assistant restarts: lights, automations and the remote are offline for about a minute. Continue?
builder.Not installed through HACS – update it t: Not installed through HACS – update it the way you installed it.
builder.Still waiting for Home Assistant… reload: Still waiting for Home Assistant… reload this page when it is back.
builder.The Builder, its texts and how Home Assi: The Builder, its texts and how Home Assistant talks to your remotes.
builder.Update checks both and only does what is: Update checks both and only does what is needed. Home Assistant only restarts when NOIR Remote itself got a new version.
Press Save after changing the channel.
The remote is up to date.
builder.The remote takes long – NOIR Remote itse: The remote takes long – NOIR Remote itself was not updated yet. Press Update again when the remote is back.
builder.This device shows the same tiles as your: This device shows the same tiles as your first remote. Change something and it gets its own home screen.
builder.This device has no infrared – the TV goe: This device has no infrared – the TV goes through Home Assistant.

remote.Kies je bronnen in de NOIR Builder: Choose your sources in NOIR Builder
remote.Nog geen lampen. Configurator → NOIR → V: No lights yet. Add them in the NOIR Builder.
remote.Eigen scènes: configurator → NOIR → Scèn: Add scenes in the NOIR Builder.
remote.Volumetoetsen op de remote regelen deze: The volume keys control this speaker.
remote.Choose your speaker in NOIR Builder > Au: Choose your speaker in NOIR Builder > Audio
remote.Choose your airco in NOIR Builder > Airc: Choose your airco in NOIR Builder > Airco
